tasks.CalculatePower: Calculate the power of n to an integer to see if it equals x.
tasks.CheckIfSimplePower: Verify if x is a simple power of n by comparing the calculated result with x.
tasks.HandleOverflow: Handle potential overflow issues for large values of n.
tasks.PrecisionCheck: Ensure that the precision of floating-point arithmetic does not affect the results.
tasks.ValidateInputs: Ensure that the inputs x and n are positive integers.
